tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (9.5:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-green-primary
tokens.usage: Authority, growth, financial stability. Used as text on `.nav-link:hover, .nav-link.active`, `.stat-icon.green`, `.progress-percentage`; border on `.nav-link:hover, .nav-link.active`. 6.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-green-success
tokens.usage: Positive metrics, profitable indicators. Used as text on `.stat-change.positive`, `.badge.status-complete`, `.text-green`. 4.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-navy-primary
tokens.usage: Trust, corporate professionalism, depth. Used as text on `.header-text h1`, `.stat-icon.navy`, `.stat-value`. 10.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-charcoal
tokens.usage: Text hierarchy, structured information. Used as text on `body`, `.progress-label`, `.checklist-text`. 13.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gray-500
tokens.usage: Secondary information, metadata. Used as text on `.header-subtitle`, `.stat-label`, `.stat-change.neutral`. 4.4:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-amber
tokens.usage: Attention items, pending reviews. Used as text on `.stat-icon.amber`, `.badge.priority-medium`, `.badge.status-pending`. 2.9:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: stat-change-text
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: text on `.stat-change.negative`, `.badge.priority-high`, `.text-red`. 4.4:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: category-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: stat-change-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.stat-change.negative`, `.badge.priority-high`.

families.display: Georgia, "Playfair Display", Garamond, "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles — as `h3` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `td.font-medium` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `div.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code and tabular figures — as `span.summary-value` on the reference page. The reference page leaves this element on the browser default face; set it in the body family.
